name: Sun Princess
intro: Princess' newest ship, built around the Piazza, a three-level gathering place under a glass Sphere, and the Dome, a glass-roofed pool by day and a theatre by night.

highlights.title: The Piazza
highlights.body: Three levels of cafes, bars and live music under the Sphere.

highlights.title: The Dome
highlights.body: A pool by day and acrobatic theatre at night.

highlights.title: Princess Arena
highlights.body: The main show venue, set up three ways for different productions.

name: Sky Princess
intro: A Royal-class ship known for the SeaWalk, a glass-bottomed walkway that reaches out over the sea, and a three-deck Piazza.

highlights.title: SeaWalk
highlights.body: A glass-bottomed walkway that extends about 28 feet beyond the side of the ship.

highlights.title: The Sanctuary
highlights.body: An adults-only retreat with private cabanas.

highlights.title: Sky Suites
highlights.body: Two top-deck suites with wraparound balconies and 270-degree views.

highlights.title: Movies Under the Stars
highlights.body: A big outdoor screen above the pool deck.

name: Sapphire Princess
intro: A mid-sized Gem-class ship with an Italian-inspired Piazza, an adults-only Serenity pool and a long Asia and Australia season.

highlights.title: The Sanctuary
highlights.body: An adults-only retreat, the last ship to receive one.

highlights.title: The Piazza
highlights.body: Italian-inspired, with an international cafe and a wine bar.

highlights.title: Skywalkers Nightclub
highlights.body: A nightclub on the top deck.

highlights.title: Movies Under the Stars
highlights.body: An outdoor screen on the pool deck.
